bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'DEBUGAI_HOST_READBACK_BEGIN\n'
printf 'HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'BRANCH='; git branch --show-current
printf 'DIRTY='; if [ -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)" ]; then echo NO; else echo YES; fi
printf 'ROLE_MODE='; if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker inspect debug-ai-debug-ai-1 --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{if eq (index (split . "=") 0) "DEBUG_AI_ROLE_EXECUTION_MODE"}}{{.}}{{end}}{{end}}' 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2- || true; fi
printf 'DEBUGAI_HOST_READBACK_END\n'
